verdict.rationale: Square documents a List Payouts API, a first-party way to see payouts and when they land. Its homepage also makes a generic 'Manage your cash flow' claim. Nothing in the evidence shows next-day or instant payout options, which is half the story, and payout visibility appears only as an API page title. missing for 10: evidence of instant/next-day transfer options and their fees, a seller-facing view of payout arrival dates, detail on payout timing fields, independent corroboration.
